headlines.title: State Street Energy SPDR (XLE) Sells $174.6 Million of Exxon on Wednesday
headlines.summary: The $39.74 billion fund sold $727.9 million of stock and bought nothing, cutting all 21 of its positions.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of ExxonMobil (XOM) on Nov. 18
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $305.7 million of ExxonMobil on Wednesday, Nov. 18, with 32 funds buying and 26 selling.

headlines.title: Guyana Oil Boom Rekindles Frontier Drilling Appetite
headlines.summary: Exxon’s success is reigniting Big Oil’s appetite for high-risk frontier exploration, demonstrating the potential rewards of long-term investment in new oil discoveries.

headlines.title: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Gets Mozambique Approval For $30 Billion Rovuma LNG Plan
headlines.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) secured Mozambican government approval for its redesigned Rovuma LNG project, a roughly US$30b development. The revised Rovuma LNG plan includes higher production capacity and a layout aimed at materially lower emissions compared with the earlier concept. Regulatory clearance positions ExxonMobil to consider a final investment decision on Rovuma LNG by the end of this year.

headlines.title: Trump Cheers the “Biggest Drop in Gasoline in 18 Years.” Not Good for Exxon and Chevron
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump cheered gasoline’s biggest drop in 18 years, and Brent crude is down 22% in November. ExxonMobil and Chevron rode the Iran war’s spike in crude to a huge 2026, and that windfall is now reversing.

description: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company operates through Upstream, Energy Products, Chemical Products, and Specialty Products segments. Its Upstream segment explores for and produces crude oil and natural gas. The Energy Products segment offers fuels, aromatics, and catalysts, as well as licensing services. Its Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells olefins, polyolefins, and intermediates. The Specialty Products segment offers finished lubricants, basestocks, waxes, synthetics, elastomers, and resins. It is also involved in the manufacture, trade, transport, and sale of crude oil, natural gas, petroleum products, petrochemicals, and other specialty products; and pursuit of lower-emission and business opportunities, including carbon capture and storage, hydrogen, lower-emission fuels, Proxxima resin systems, carbon materials, low-carbon data center, and lithium. In addition, the company offers aviation fuel. It sells its products under the Exxon, Esso, and Mobil brands. The company was formerly known as Exxon Mobil Corporation and changed its name to ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation in July 2026. ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Spring, Texas.
